stages.name: Goal
stages.desc: The objective is fixed and hashed before anything runs. Every later step is checked against this exact hash.

excerpt.immutable_goal: A prioritized, executable elevation plan for the live grahama.co: harsh critique of the current site, restrained 2026 motion language, unified art direction for the 10 project imag…

stages.invariant: goal_hash is frozen; any drift trips goal_hash_mismatch and the run fails closed.
stages.proves: The work was pinned to one stated objective, identified by a content hash.
stages.not: That the objective itself is the right thing to build.

stages.name: Bounded context
stages.desc: Limits, required evidence, and fail-closed conditions are declared up front — the agent operates inside a fence.
stages.invariant: Missing any required-evidence artifact aborts the run rather than reporting success.
stages.proves: Permissions, timeouts, and stop conditions existed before the agent acted.
stages.not: That the chosen bounds are sufficient for every risk.

stages.name: Constrained execution
stages.desc: The exact command Tau dispatched, with its side-effect declaration, recorded verbatim.
stages.invariant: mutates:false is a declared contract — a write would contradict the receipt and fail review.
stages.proves: What ran, whether it could mutate state, and its timeout — captured, not narrated.
stages.not: That the reviewer's output is semantically correct.

stages.name: Captured evidence
stages.desc: The handler receipt records that a real provider answered live — not a mock, not a claim.
stages.invariant: live:true with mocked:false is required; a mocked lane cannot satisfy the evidence gate.
stages.proves: A real model produced this seat's response, on the record, at a stamped time.
stages.not: That the response's content is right — only that it genuinely occurred.

stages.name: Deterministic judgment
stages.desc: A join gate — not a model — counts usable seats and emits a PASS/FAIL verdict against a typed schema.
stages.invariant: The verdict is computed from seat receipts; it cannot be set by a model asserting success.
stages.proves: A deterministic gate ran and recorded how many seats actually returned usable work.
stages.not: That the panel's collective judgment is correct.

stages.name: Receipt
stages.desc: The top-level receipt carries its own explicit boundary — what it proves and, just as loudly, what it does not.

excerpt.proves: Tau's real CLI was invoked against the emitted DAG artifact.
excerpt.does_not_prove: Provider calls occurred unless provider_live is true and provider receipts are present.

stages.invariant: The receipt states its own does-not-prove list; the claim can never exceed the evidence.
stages.proves: The run reached a typed terminal state with a scoped, self-limiting proof statement.
stages.not: That PASS means the design advice was good — only that the process is accountable.
